environment: Node VM with real local assets and in-memory caches; no physical-device offline claim

results.name: Install verifies and caches every real manifest asset without automatic activation
Activation uses its event argument, removes only older own caches, and claims clients
Offline fetch returns exact cached original bytes even with a query string
Only same-scope GET requests are intercepted; an uncached request uses the network
corrupt asset rejects installation and deletes only the incomplete new cache
missing asset rejects installation and deletes only the incomplete new cache
Only the explicit private Nitnem update message requests skipWaiting
